name: guitaralchemist
description: Claude Code plugins and mods for the GuitarAlchemist ecosystem (ix, ga, tars, Demerzel, gaia, learn): the ones that work across repos live here, the ones that belong to a repo are listed from it

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Coordination across the agent fleet: the AI scrum, a round table of what every session, subagent and pull request is doing, with the collisions, stale lanes and decisions waiting on the user

plugins.name: session-inbox
plugins.description: Holds messages from other sessions in an /inbox pane instead of interrupting the turn, and adds working groups in ~/.agents/groups.json that you and the model can post to

plugins.name: shared-repo-guard
plugins.description: Holds blanket git commands in the shared clones for the user's confirmation, with what they would touch; adds /lanes and a /prs pane of open pull requests and their CI

plugins.name: ga
plugins.description: Guitar Alchemist DSL: music theory tools, chord analysis, tab search and GA Language commands. It runs GaMcpServer from the current directory, so it works only in a session started inside a ga checkout
